caption:
On test day, stop guessing which Module 2 you got.

Module 2 is set harder or easier based on Module 1, but Module 1 is locked by then. Whichever you get, the job is the same: keep your pace, answer everything, mark and revisit.

Follow @samsonsatprep for daily SAT tips.
tiktok_caption: On test day, stop guessing which Module 2 you got. Dec 5 SAT: same job either way.

youtube.title: Don't Try to Decode Your SAT Module 2
youtube.description: The digital SAT's second module adapts to how you did on the first, but guessing which version you got only burns focus. A reminder five days before the December 5, 2026 SAT.
